_comment: MistLand — default simulation parameters. Keys prefixed with '_comment' are ignored by the simulation.

world._comment: Global world parameters. Conserved quantities (water, energy) are distributed at generation and should remain constant.
world._comment_seed: Random seed for world generation. Change to get a different world layout.
world._comment_total_water: Total water per cell on average. 0.5 = half-saturated world. Increase for more oceans, decrease for a drier world.
world._comment_total_energy: Reserved for future use (external energy exchange with sun/radiation).
world._comment_solar_radiation: Base solar energy input per tick. Modulated by day/night cycle and albedo. Higher = more energy, higher temperatures, more evaporation.
world._comment_sun_rotation_speed: Speed of the sun's rotation around the world. Higher = faster day/night cycle.

base_types._comment: Static properties per ground type. bare=rock, sand=sand, soil=fertile ground.

bare._comment: Rock — retains no water, heats and cools quickly, floods easily (low threshold).
bare._comment_thermal_inertia: How slowly the cell exchanges heat with neighbours. Higher = slower change.
bare._comment_water_retention: Minimum ground_water kept even on high ground (prevents total drainage).
bare._comment_flooding_threshold: ground_water level above which cell becomes a lake. Lower = floods easily.
bare._comment_albedo_base: Base energy reflection fraction. Higher = reflects more = stays cooler.

sand._comment: Sand — low thermal inertia (heats fast), slight water retention, moderate flood threshold.

soil._comment: Soil — moderate inertia, good water retention, hard to flood (high threshold).

temperature._comment: Controls heat exchange rates between ground, atmosphere and neighbours. All rates in [0..1] fraction per tick.
temperature._comment_ground_to_neighbour_rate: Fraction of ground temperature radiated to each of the 8 neighbours per tick. Modulated by thermal_inertia.
temperature._comment_ground_to_atmosphere_rate: Used to compute the net ground<->atmosphere exchange rate (averaged with atmosphere_to_ground_rate).
temperature._comment_atmosphere_to_ground_rate: Used to compute the net ground<->atmosphere exchange rate (averaged with ground_to_atmosphere_rate).

atmosphere._comment: Controls pressure computation and wind-driven transport.
atmosphere._comment_vortex_number: Number of vortices in the world. Each vortex adds a rotational component to the wind, creating more dynamic and less uniform wind patterns.
atmosphere._comment_vortex_pull: Strength of the vortex's influence on the wind. Higher = stronger winds around the vortex center, creating more pronounced cyclones and anticyclones.
atmosphere._comment_vortex_spin: Amount of rotational (tangential) velocity added to the wind around the vortex center. Higher = more swirling, less linear winds.
atmosphere._comment_vortex_eye_ratio: Size of the vortex eye as a fraction of the maximum vortex influence radius. Higher = larger calm center with less wind, smaller = more intense winds closer to the center.
atmosphere._comment_P_base: Baseline atmospheric pressure (bar). Pressure deviates from this value based on temperature and altitude.
atmosphere._comment_k_temp: Weight of temperature deviation in pressure formula. Higher = temperature has more influence on wind.
atmosphere._comment_k_alt: Weight of altitude in pressure formula. Higher = mountains create stronger pressure gradients.
atmosphere._comment_temp_ref: Reference temperature (°C) at which pressure equals P_base. Cells warmer than this have lower pressure.
atmosphere._comment_k_wind: Wind strength coefficient. wind(A→B) = k_wind * (pressure(A) - pressure(B)). Higher = stronger winds.
atmosphere._comment_pressure_damping: How fast pressure converges toward its target each tick. 1.0 = instant, 0.1 = slow drift (more stable).
atmosphere._comment_wind_transport_rate: Fraction of atmospheric content (mist, temperature) transported by wind per tick.
atmosphere._comment_mist_pressure_factor: mist augments pressure by this amount per mist level, simulating the weight of water vapor. Higher = mistier areas have higher pressure, affecting wind patterns.
atmosphere._comment_wind_noise_strength: Amplitude of the noise perturbation added to wind each tick.
atmosphere._comment_wind_noise_coarse_factor: Downscale factor for the coarse noise grid (W/factor × H/factor). Higher = larger, smoother eddies.
atmosphere._comment_wind_noise_persistence: O-U persistence per tick [0..1]. 0.99 = significant change every ~100 ticks; 0.9 = every ~10 ticks.
atmosphere._comment_mist_cooling_factor: Temperature reduction (°C) per mist level. Higher = mist cools the atmosphere more, increasing pressure and wind effects.
atmosphere._comment_lapse_rate: Temperature decrease (°C) per altitude unit. Higher = stronger cooling at high altitudes, increasing pressure gradients and wind effects around mountains.

water._comment: Controls the water cycle : evaporation, runoff, and hydraulic altitude.
water._comment_evap_temp_threshold: Ground temperature (°C) above which evaporation occurs. Lower = more evaporation overall.
water._comment_evap_rate: Fraction of available ground water evaporated per tick when above threshold.
water._comment_evap_water_temp_threshold: Water temperature (°C) above which evaporation occurs. Lower = more evaporation overall.
water._comment_runoff_rate: Fraction of available water flowing downhill per tick. Lower = slower rivers, fewer oscillations.
water._comment_water_to_altitude: Converts ground_water to an equivalent altitude for runoff calculation. effective_alt = terrain_alt + gw * water_to_altitude. Higher = flooded cells retain water more (less overflow).
water._comment_ground_water_diffusion_rate: Fraction of ground water each non-lake cell spreads equally to its 8 neighbours per tick.
water._comment_mist_to_groundwater: units of groungwater generated by one unit of mist
water._comment_erosion_rate: Fraction of water outflow volume that erodes the terrain per tick. Higher = faster erosion, more dynamic terrain changes (but can cause instability if too high).

rain._comment: Controls precipitation. Rain occurs when atmo_temp < threshold AND mist >= humidity_threshold.
rain._comment_rain_temp_threshold: Atmospheric temperature (°C) below which rain can occur. Raise to make rain more frequent.
rain._comment_rain_humidity_threshold: Minimum mist level [0..7] required to trigger rain. Lower = rain more easily.
rain._comment_rain_rate: Fraction of mist converted to ground water per rainy tick.
rain._comment_rain_saturation_threshold: Mist level at which rain is forced, even if temperature is above threshold. Simulates heavy storms when mist is maxed out.

snow._comment: Controls snow dynamics. Snow accumulates when atmo_temp < threshold, and melts when atmo_temp > melt_threshold.
snow._comment_snow_temp_threshold: Atmospheric temperature (°C) below which snow can accumulate. Lower = less snow overall.
snow._comment_mist_to_snow_rate: Fraction of mist converted to snow per tick when temperature is below threshold.
snow._comment_snow_to_water_threshold: Atmospheric temperature (°C) above which snow starts melting. Higher = snow lasts longer.
snow._comment_snow_melting_rate: Maximum fraction of ground snow converted to ground water per tick when above melt threshold.

nutriments._comment: Controls nutriment dynamics : diffusion, lake generation, and runoff transport.
nutriments._comment_diffusion_rate: Fraction of a cell's nutriments diffused to each neighbour per tick. Simulates microfauna movement.
nutriments._comment_lake_generation_rate: Nutriment units generated for lake neighbours per tick. Lakes fertilise their banks.
nutriments._comment_runoff_transport_rate: Fraction of lake outflow converted to nutriments for downstream cells.

vegetation._comment: Controls vegetation growth, devolution, and resource consumption. growth_period and thresholds interact with fertility field.
vegetation._comment_growth_period_ticks: Minimum ticks between two growth events for a cell. Counter resets to a random value in [0, period/2] on each change (desynchronisation).
vegetation._comment_water_min: Minimum ground_water required for growth. Modulated by fertility (±fertility_water_range).
vegetation._comment_nutriments_min: Minimum nutriments required for growth (except lichens). Modulated by fertility (±fertility_nut_range).
vegetation._comment_growth_cost_water: Ground water consumed on each growth step (moved to vegetation_water store).
vegetation._comment_mist_water_threshold: Minimum mist level required for lichen growth.
vegetation._comment_growth_cost_nutriments: Nutriments consumed on each growth step.
vegetation._comment_water_stored_per_level: Reserved — not currently used in computation.
vegetation._comment_devolution_nutriments_release: Nutriments released to ground on each devolution step.
vegetation._comment_devolution_water_release: Reserved — previously used for mist release on devolution.

albedo._comment: Controls how vegetation modifies cell albedo.
albedo._comment_vegetation_reduction_per_level: Albedo reduction per vegetation level. Trees (level 4) reduce albedo by 0.20, making vegetated areas absorb more heat.

lichens._comment: Lichens : lowest growth requirements, only on bare ground, no fertility bonus, no water storage, low albedo reduction.

grass._comment: Grass : moderate growth requirements, on sand or soil, benefits from fertility, moderate albedo reduction.

shrubs._comment: Shrubs : higher growth requirements, on sand or soil, benefits from fertility, higher albedo reduction.

trees._comment: Trees : highest growth requirements, only on soil, benefits most from fertility, highest albedo reduction.
